text: Removed the AtomicReference registry. DomainFactory.restore now accepts an immutable DomainRegistry and returns the updated DomainResolution; fresh resource constructors start isolated scopes, while semanticIn/structuralCompatibilityIn/locusIn/volumeIn/surfaceIn APIs thread caller-owned scopes. Dataset, volume, surface, spatial, connectivity, radial, and atlas quotients retain their resulting registry snapshot. Shared JVM/JS courts cover scope isolation, canonical restore, typed conflict, immutable branching, and ephemeral cleanup. Legacy voxel ordinals were not reinterpreted; no generic DomainStore[F] was introduced.
